newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt pound overnight soar in tight market.
newsitem.headline: Egypt pound overnight soar in tight market.

text.p: Overnight interbank rates on the Egyptian pound soared in early trading on Thursday but a Central Bank announcement that it would issue a 700 million pound ($206 million) repo helped ease rates, bankers said.
Bankers said they made deals at 11 and 11-1/4 percent but the rates slipped to around 10-1/2 percent after news of the repo. Wednesday's rates were between 10-1/8 and 10-5/16 percent.
The bankers said the 700 million pound T-bill repo would be valid for four days from Sunday.
"Things will hopefully change a little (after the repo). There's no money to be found anywhere," one banker said
Public sector banks, the lenders of last resort, offer minimum lending rates of 10-1/2 percent.
Some bankers said they did not make any one-week deals because of the shortage in the market while others quoted rates of around 10-1/2 percent, up from 10-7/16 percent on Wednesday.
